question: In what locus does dissolution occur, and what is the full set of things that go to dissolution that must be told?
premises: Dissolution is said to occur in some locus.
All of that which undergoes dissolution is a determinate set.
The speaker requests a full account of both points.
inference: A complete explanation is requested of the locus of dissolution and of everything that goes to dissolution.
uncertainties: Neither the locus nor the set is identified in this verse.
plain_english: In what does it indeed go to dissolution? Tell me all of that.
